description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Branchsnap Lorian enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.
